question: By what means and in what manner is one claimed to be able to show one's own body?
premises: One may show one's own body.
This is possible by constant meditation.
It may be shown in many ways.
inference: Through constant meditation, one's own body may be manifested in many ways.
uncertainties: Whether 'show' means manifest, project, or perceive is not determined here.
plain_english: By constant meditation, one may show one's own body in many ways.
